title: Income Supplement to the Quarterly OTC Load by Household Income Band
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — income-band schedule for the over-the-counter allowance.** An income supplement is added to the member's quarter load of the over-the-counter allowance according to the household income recorded on the member's plan membership.

**Rule.** The income supplement is seven dollars fifty ($7.50) for a member whose active plan membership records household income at or below 138 percent of the federal poverty level, five dollars ($5.00) for income above 138 and at or below 185 percent, and nothing above 185 percent.

The income read is the household income, as a percent of the federal poverty level, recorded on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership in active status.

### Income bands

| Household income on the active membership (percent of the federal poverty level) | Income supplement added to the quarter load |
|---|---|
| At or below 138 | $7.50 |
| Above 138, at or below 185 | $5.00 |
| Above 185 | Nothing |

### Band edges (hypothetical incomes)

| Recorded income | Band | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 138 percent | at or below 138 | $7.50 |
| 139 percent | above 138, at or below 185 | $5.00 |
| 185 percent | above 138, at or below 185 | $5.00 |
| 186 percent | above 185 | Nothing |
